title: IMAP Email Service State
description: Listens on an IMAP mailbox and pushes each new incoming email as a structured object into the pipeline. (Runtimes: node; IDs: imap-email)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

tls.description: Use TLS (recommended — disable only for plain-text port 143)

enabled.description: Whether to listen; persisted, so a saved board reconnects on load

connect.description: Send { connect: true } to start, { connect: false } to stop

disconnect.description: Send { disconnect: true } to stop the connection

running.description: Whether a connection is up right now

reconnectAttempts.description: Attempts since the connection was last up; 0 while connected
